analyses.outcome_group: Adequate diagnostic sampling with rapid on-site evaluation
analyses.timepoint_policy: Select source-defined adequate-sample outcomes from the index diagnostic procedure. Do not substitute diagnostic accuracy, diagnostic yield, sensitivity for malignancy, needle passes, or complications.

rules: Select one complete binary adequate-sampling record per report when it compares rapid on-site cytologic evaluation with no rapid on-site evaluation.

Require source-defined adequate-sample counts, group denominators, and a RD. Where a study has multiple intervention arms, use only a contrast with the same sampling modality and needle system in both groups.
Do not use target-review forest rows, review totals, article-specific labels, or target combined effects.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
